title: Mixed Event — As the Leaves Change Once More — Episode8 The Four of Us

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More
meta.Event Outline: After the success at Jam Fest, Shiho is energized to practice. But Shizuku and Saki invite her on a day trip to relax and enjoy the fall foliage.

rows.Line: Aboard a train

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm...? Tsukasa...? Wanna have another grape...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: More... More... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They're talking in their sleep...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Even in their dreams, they're inseparable.
They both seem so happy right now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Mhm...
I'm stuffed, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You can also take a nap if you want, Shizuku. I'll wake you guys when we get to the station.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm okay.
If anything, Shii, you're more than welcome to use my shoulder as a pillow.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll pass.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: B-But...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Still, Shii...
Today's trip ended up being very fun, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it was fun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I honestly wasn't all that enthusiastic about this at first... But I enjoyed things more than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki and I have been really busy since going pro, but I think this trip was just the break we needed.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks for inviting me, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
...!
Of course!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm so glad to hear that you had fun today, Shii...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I know.
Why don't we go on a trip together sometime? Just the two of us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure there are plenty more places you'd like to visit and things you would like to see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We could go to some hot springs, see cherry blossoms and even spend a day at the beach...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We could also go leaf-viewing and sample local delicacies like this again...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, there's no way we're gonna be able to find the time to do all those things.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you think so?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: M-Mhm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yawn...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You two seem to be having a fun conversation... What were you talking about just now?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. We didn't mean to wake you two.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But we were just discussing our next trip.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! Next trip...?!
Take me with you! I wanna go!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How are you immediately awake?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we should all go on another trip together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yay! Alright, what are we gonna see next?!
Cherry blossoms? The beach?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, we actually just mentioned those things.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Both are excellent choices.
We can add them to the list of places we weren't able to visit today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally♪
That means we gotta start coming up with a new itinerary!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Things are starting to snowball again...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I guess I wouldn't mind going again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho's also on board!
Now I feel even more excited about our next trip!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
And we're gonna have lots of fun again when we go!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm hoping that we'll get to create more wonderful memories together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, me too...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But this time, you guys actually have to come up with everything yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not a problem! We're going to come up with a trip that surpasses the leaf-viewing extravaganza we just experienced! Right, you two?!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Now you're starting to worry me...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Our next trip, huh...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'll probably have to help them plan things again...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But if it means getting to spend time with them like this again, then, well, maybe that's not so bad.)
